lexemes.definition: A meeting held to transfer relevant information and responsibility for ongoing work.
lexemes.example: The handover meeting covers the open issue and the next responsible contact.

image.brief: An original fictional scene of colleagues transferring ongoing work information and identifying the next responsible contact; no real personal or organizational records.
